status: migration draft; not the production API

identity.backend_generation: isolates browser cache, sessions and unknown requests across backend changes
identity.writer_epoch: prevents an old service or delayed external task from writing after ownership changes

c0_test_endpoints.availability: non-production only; requires a separately configured C0_TEST_KEY
c0_test_endpoints.purpose: verifies SQLite transactions, immutable request results, eviction recovery, outbox and alarm retries
c0_test_endpoints.business_status: not a signup, scheduling, seating or archive API

bridge_probe.availability: non-production only; requires C0_TEST_KEY plus server-side GOOGLE_BRIDGE_URL and GOOGLE_BRIDGE_SECRET
bridge_probe.status: C0 transport and replay proof only; no Form or Sheet business mutation

request_id.format: 8 to 128 ASCII letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens
request_id.result_lookup: C1 must expose only through the same public or authenticated actor boundary as the original action

migration_rules.current_contract: contracts/api-v1.json remains authoritative for the Apps Script production service
migration_rules.old_sessions: do not migrate; every Coach signs in again after cutover
migration_rules.completed_requests: migrate request scope, original request ID, parameter digest and immutable result
migration_rules.old_hmac: preserve UTF-8 HMAC-SHA256 and unpadded base64url; preserve historical JSON.stringify field order
